verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform, so a documented public API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only inbound source-system integrations (ERP, CRM, HRIS) and an Excel connector, which are adjacent features rather than a public API. Probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs at every candidate path returned 404, and no API documentation is cited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
